theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fcd_jwc_covector_det_expansion
theorems.statement: ∀ (N' k : ℕ) (f : Covector (Euclid N') k) (u : Fin k → Euclid N'), (k.factorial : ℝ) * f u = ∑ I : Fin k → Fin N', f (fun c => EuclideanSpace.single (I c) (1 : ℝ)) * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun c b => u b (I c))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
